item.title: NO-SHOW Definition & Meaning - Merriam-Webster
item.description: The meaning of NO-SHOW is a person who reserves space (as on an airplane) but neither uses nor cancels the reservation.

item.title: No-show (airlines) - Wikipedia
item.description: Some airlines include a no-show clause in their Contract of carriage. It basically means that a user not showing up for the outbound flight will be considered a no-show, and all the connecting flights associated with this one, even a return flight, will be cancelled and no refund will apply.

item.title: NO-SHOW | English meaning - Cambridge Dictionary
item.description: NO-SHOW definition: 1. a person who is expected but does not arrive: 2. the act of not arriving when you are expected…. Learn more.

item.description: Discover what flight no-show entails. Learn how it can affect your travel plans and potential refunds, and what steps to take to minimise the inconvenience.

item.title: How to avoid an airline no-show error that can cancel your trip
item.description: Airline no-show errors can cancel return flights and cost travelers hundreds. Here's how to protect yourself.

item.title: An airline no-show means problems unless travelers know what they are ...
item.description: In general, being an airline no-show for a ticketed airline flight means a traveler will lose any value on the ticket. This means, in general, it’s not a great idea. On the other hand, there are times when it’s a very sensible alternative to be an airline no-show.

item.title: What Is No-Show? Definition & Examples (2026) | SchedulingKit
item.description: A no-show occurs when a booked client does not appear for their scheduled appointment and has not communicated a cancellation or reschedule. No-shows waste valuable time that could have been sold to other clients, directly impacting revenue.

item.title: No Show Fee: Meaning & How to Avoid It | No-Show Definition
item.description: A no-show fee applies when a passenger misses their flight without canceling, whereas a cancellation involves notifying the airline in advance, which may allow for a refund or rebooking.

item.title: No-shows - definition of no-shows by The Free Dictionary
item.description: no′-show` n. 1. a person who has a reservation or ticket and does not use or cancel it. 2. a person who unexpectedly fails to show up, as for an appointment.
